notes.title: Little Green Girl - Episode 1 on Steam! FREE

tags.feature: - 15 hours of exciting reading absolutely free;
- a romantic comedy in a high school setting;
- an opportunity to build love with a real alien girl;
- bright and well-developed characters with their own secrets;
- excellent artwork by OrikaNekoi (Moe Era, Herbalist, etc.);
- great comedy from Terian - the writer of "Buns, Kefir and Rock and Roll" (the best mod for "Everlasting Summer" of all time)
- a pinch of drama and fanservice;

notes.title: MacOS X and GNU/Linux versions!
notes.content:
1.2.3.1375 (25.12.2016):
- MacOS X and GNU/Linux builds are now avaliable
- achievements list is synced with Steam in both directions, what you see at Steam is what you see in the game
- major performance optimizations at craft screen on item take/put
- bioms and special locations support at forest for mods and future use
- no more "final" items, any item now can be used in recipe 
- tweaks on achievement conditions: Master chef, Foodie

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26760893/49aa8e1208c1a09deda99c6d06bb336cb4e09344.png[/img]

notes.title: The Herbalist Workshop is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]We've started the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/542260/workshop/] Workshop[/url]!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26760893/d035b3ded177dc3128d757b49176e73c79ba660e.png[/img] 

Now you can create and use mods. [/h1]

Also we have fixed some minor bugs.

[b]Changelog:[/b]

1.2.1.1268 (05.12.2016):
- mods loader now ignores mods without descript.ion
- tweaks on conditions to achievements: Herbalist, Alchemist, Potion Master, Inventor, Shortcut
- removed extra dirty pots when crafting: Tar, Potion of Clairvoyance, Powder of Happiness
- junk selling statistics is now displayed at the book correctly
- minor game script and localization bugfix
